writeup: TIC 405216391 is a candidate eclipsing binary star system with an orbital period of 3.1145 days. Automated analysis of TESS photometry detected a primary eclipse causing the system to dim by 7.08%, with a transit-detection signal-to-noise of 233.5. Pixel-level image analysis confirmed this signal at a peak signal-to-noise of 137.4, though the centroid offset measured 4.2 arcsec from the target coordinates. No secondary eclipse was detected in the available data. The system does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, suggesting it may be a previously uncatalogued candidate. The pipeline's machine-learning classifier assigned this target a score of 0.26 on its likelihood scale, and the photometric data passed all quality checks without flagging concerns.
